# Sleepwalk Press

> Sleepwalk (Sleepwalk Press) is an independent, small-run publisher of artist books and experimental texts by artists and writers, working across photography, collage, drawing, essay, fiction, and criticism. Based in Prague, Czech Republic.

The website is currently a single-page placeholder while the full catalogue and online store are in development. It announces upcoming releases and offers a newsletter sign-up.

- Contact: info@sleepwalk.site
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/sleepwalkbooks/
- Location: Prague, Czech Republic

Upcoming releases:

- *The Whole World Held Together by Spider Webs* — Rachael Thorleifson, August 2026
- *Temptation: Sacred Architecture & Modern Thought* — John Patterson, September 2026
- "Information Overload!" Everything Tote — September 2026

- [Home](https://sleepwalk.site/): Publisher statement, upcoming releases, and newsletter sign-up.
